description: This file implements functions related to RPC server invocation and a controller class for connectors within the WPEFramework namespace. It defines methods for creating and managing RPC invoke servers, including a default invoke server and a worker pool invoke server, as well as a singleton pattern for the ConnectorController class.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A nested class within DefaultInvokeServer() that extends RPC::InvokeServerType to implement a custom invoke server with acquire and relinquish methods.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: A singleton class managing a connector controller, with constructor, destructor, and a static instance.

methods.name: DefaultInvokeServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to the default RPC invoke server, encapsulating an Engine instance.

methods.name: WorkerPoolInvokeServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy to a worker pool-based RPC invoke server.
